supporting_observations.claim: At 13:39:57 UTC, WS-ICHEN-01 recorded a network logon for sam.okafor from WS-SOKAFOR-01, consistent with the inventory's stated remote-administration source.
At 13:42:01 UTC, PowerShell ran as NWD\sam.okafor with the exact command and script path specified in the organization's workstation-patching practice: \\FILE-NWD-01\Admin\Apply-Updates.ps1.

The execution falls within the stated business-hours patching window and shortly follows the reported approximate 13:40 UTC time; those facts are consistent with the reported brief PowerShell appearance, though the logs do not establish what was visible on screen.

At the time the script ran, proxy telemetry recorded a Windows Update Agent connection to download.windowsupdate.com with about 38.8 MB received; the script then launched wusa.exe to install a Windows update package.
The update installer exited, followed by the PowerShell process exiting under sam.okafor's account.

Separately, DC-NWD-01 attempted connections to WS-ICHEN-01 on ports 8080, 443, 445, and 135; the recorded attempts were rejected or had no completed connection. The available evidence does not explain these attempts.

known_telemetry_limitations: Process and network records support the patching explanation, but do not show the script's contents or independently verify the integrity of the script or update package.
The records do not capture the desktop or establish whether a PowerShell window was visible to ivy.chen.

The DC-to-workstation connection attempts are recorded, but the provided telemetry does not identify their initiating activity beyond the recorded processes and connection outcomes (T044-00127 through T044-00134).
claims_not_established: Whether the PowerShell window was actually visible to ivy.chen, or whether she observed a different event.
Whether the script or downloaded update was modified or contained unexpected behavior.
Whether the DC-NWD-01 connection attempts were authorized activity or malicious probing.
Whether activity outside the supplied records or time window occurred.
additional_evidence_needed: Verify the version, signature, and contents of \\FILE-NWD-01\Admin\Apply-Updates.ps1 and the installed update package; review relevant file-access and update-installation logs.
Check DC-NWD-01 service, task, and network-connection telemetry around 13:51 UTC to explain the attempts to WS-ICHEN-01 on ports 8080, 443, 445, and 135.
If confirming the reported visual event is necessary, obtain user confirmation or relevant endpoint UI/session telemetry.
